name: scheduler-create
description: Create a new scheduled job: cron_expr for a recurring job, run_at (ISO 8601) for a one-shot. For a recurring operational routine pass only cron_expr and task; intent_anchor creates a persistent multi-burst task and is not for operational sweeps. Only for a job that does not exist yet. A change to an existing routine (new time, reworded task) is scheduler-update action=edit on that job: creating instead leaves the old job running, so the task fires twice. An additional run alongside an existing routine ("also on Fridays") is a new job and belongs here. Check scheduler-list first. An exact copy of an active job (same agent, task and schedule) is refused. When an active job for the same agent runs the same task on another schedule, the job is created and similar_active_jobs lists the others; if the request was to change one of them rather than add a run, cancel the new job and edit the existing one.

inputs.error_budget: object? (resumable task config only: resumable, max_stalls, max_iterations, max_wallclock_hours, max_cost_usd — not per-invocation turn limits)
inputs.timezone: string? (IANA timezone name, e.g. America/Toronto — overrides Curia's default timezone for this job's cron schedule)

outputs.similar_active_jobs: object[]? (present when other active jobs for the same agent run the same task on a different schedule — {jobId, status, cronExpr, runAt} each)
